verdict.rationale: GitBook's docs only describe Git sync of source markdown to GitHub/GitLab and a hosted SaaS site with custom domain/branding — there is no documented static-bundle export of the rendered site for self-hosting elsewhere, and community commentary explicitly complains GitBook 'moved everything to their SaaS with artificial barriers to just using the software' and deprecated its open-source CLI, reinforcing lock-in rather than portability.
